name: serhovskyi-waveflow
description: waveflow — Wave Development Flow: the wave pipeline for executing multi-plan features one link per session, and the harness that guards the shared tree it runs in.

plugins.name: wave-skills
plugins.description: Execute a wave of sub-plans one link per session without drowning the controller's context. Five skills — wave-grill before the wave, wave-prep, wave-run and wave-close for it, wave-retro after it — plus the evidence auditor, architecture, spec and standards reviewers they dispatch.

plugins.name: wave-harness
plugins.description: Hooks and evidence tools for sessions sharing one working tree: refuse irreversible git, warn on blind commands, record gate runs with their own EXIT=. Repo rules come from .claude/harness.toml.
